branding.altText: Tabletop club members around a game table

experience.tagline: Board game nights, loaner games, and dues for local tabletop fans.

personas.label: Organizer
personas.description: Plans game nights, manages the game library, and collects dues.

personas.label: Member
personas.description: RSVPs to game nights, borrows games, and pays dues.

workflows.title: RSVP to Friday game night
workflows.entryText: Friday game night at the community room, 7-10pm. 12 of 20 seats filled.
workflows.actionText: Reserve a seat at Friday's game night.
workflows.resultText: You're on the roster for Friday's game night.

workflows.title: RSVP to the afternoon tournament
workflows.entryText: Summer tournament earlier the same day, 1-5pm. 8 of 16 brackets claimed.
workflows.actionText: Claim a bracket in the summer tournament.
workflows.resultText: Your bracket is reserved for the summer tournament.

workflows.title: Decide on new game purchase
workflows.entryText: A member proposed buying a copy of Wingspan for the club library.
workflows.actionText: Decide on the Wingspan purchase proposal.
workflows.resultText: Decision recorded for the Wingspan proposal.

workflows.title: Borrow a game from the club library
workflows.entryText: Catan is available in the club game library.
workflows.actionText: Request to borrow Catan for two weeks.
workflows.resultText: Your loan request for Catan was sent to the organizer.

workflows.title: Pay quarterly club dues
workflows.entryText: Quarterly dues of $15 are due by the end of the month.
workflows.resultText: Dues payment recorded and receipt saved.

givingPayment.entitlement: Member in good standing through the quarter

workflows.title: Publish game night announcement
workflows.entryText: Draft: 'Friday game night moves to the larger room starting next week.'
workflows.actionText: Publish the game night announcement to all members.
workflows.resultText: Announcement published to all Tabletop Club members.

tabletop-game-night-rsvp.receiverEntryText: A member RSVP'd to Friday's game night.
tabletop-game-night-rsvp.receiverResultText: RSVP acknowledged and added to the roster.

tabletop-tournament-rsvp.receiverEntryText: A member claimed a bracket in the summer tournament.
tabletop-tournament-rsvp.receiverResultText: Bracket acknowledged and added to the tournament board.

tabletop-committee-decision.receiverEntryText: The committee decided on the Wingspan purchase proposal.

tabletop-game-loan.receiverEntryText: A member requested to borrow Catan from the club library.
tabletop-game-loan.receiverResultText: Loan approved and logged in the club library.

tabletop-club-dues-payment.receiverResultText: Dues payment confirmed and receipt issued.

tabletop-meetup-announcement.receiverEntryText: The organizer published a new game night announcement.

messages.body: Welcome to the Tabletop Club! Our first game night is Friday at 7pm in the community room.
Thanks! I'll bring snacks and my copy of Catan.
Can we try Wingspan this week? I've been wanting to play it.
Great idea — I'll reserve the main table and bring my copy.

marketplaceListings.title: Catan
marketplaceListings.description: Classic resource-trading strategy game for 3-4 players. Includes 5-6 player expansion.

marketplaceListings.title: Wingspan
marketplaceListings.description: Award-winning engine-building bird game. Includes European expansion.

marketplaceListings.title: Root
marketplaceListings.description: Asymmetric woodland strategy game. Faction boards for 3-4 players.

marketplaceListings.title: Catan (retired club copy)
marketplaceListings.description: Free to a member — retired club copy, replaced by the newer set above.
